stemMd: Five talks A, B, C, D and E occupy consecutive slots. A is before B, B immediately precedes C, D is first and E is last. Which talk is third?
explanationMd: The middle three slots contain A, B and C. A precedes the adjacent pair B,C, forcing D,A,B,C,E.

distractorRationale.b: E is fixed in the last slot.
distractorRationale.c: A must occupy the second slot.
distractorRationale.a: D is fixed in the first slot.
distractorRationale.e: C immediately follows the third-slot talk.
